title: Austin Mayor's Annual Report 1874
summary:
• **Meeting Called for Mayor's Report**: Mayor De Gress convened the city council to present his mandatory annual report to aldermen, a key accountability measure for the city's leadership.

• **Quorum Issues**: The October 15th meeting had to be adjourned due to insufficient attendance—only 4 of 10 aldermen showed up, preventing any official business from being conducted.

• **Successful Second Meeting**: A follow-up meeting on October 24th achieved quorum with 7 aldermen present, allowing the mayor's report to proceed as planned.
